- U8: Expose counter (metrics) endpoints to feed dashboards for firehose | counter pipe.

technical_and_design_decisions: Baseline on Java 17 with Spring Framework 6 / Spring Boot 3 generation of Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s) and Spring Cloud Data (s-c-d), per the specification's Java 17+ requirement.

U1: Binder jars are included/excluded via explicit configuration properties plus classpath detection; when no binding is configured, a defined fallback binder is selected with a clear warning instead of failing silently.

U2: Runtime dependency resolution is implemented with Maven Resolver (Aether) to resolve module artifacts and transitive dependencies; conflicting jar versions across modules are handled with per-module isolated classloaders so each module loads its own resolved bits.

U3: The s-c-d image is built from a layered executable jar (Dockerfile), and a CI pipeline (GitHub Actions) builds and pushes to DockerHub on every relevant commit, tagging images with both the commit SHA and 'latest'.

U5: Undeploy is modeled as an operation on the deployer SPI so the strategy is consistent for jobs and streams; the singlenode (single JVM) implementation stops the running modules and removes their in-memory deployment state.

U6: Spring Profiles drive the repository backend strategy in the Admin application; the 'local' profile activates an in-memory (map-backed) StreamRepository implementation selected via conditional configuration.

U7: XD modules are ported as standalone Spring Cloud Stream applications following the source/processor/sink model, with shared conventions and auto-configuration starters as the migration foundation.
U8: Counter metrics are collected in a counter repository and exposed as REST endpoints on the Admin application (e.g., /metrics/counters) with a JSON contract suitable for dashboard consumption.
assumptions: 's-c-d' refers to Spring Cloud Data (Flow) and 's-c-s' to Spring Cloud Stream; the work is performed inside the existing spring-cloud-data and spring-cloud-stream codebases, which already build with Maven.

A single senior developer performs all work; effort estimates include analysis, design, implementation, unit/integration testing, and developer documentation, but exclude external community review turnaround time.
DockerHub credentials and existing CI infrastructure are available for U3.
For U4, the screencast effort covers demo environment preparation, scripting, recording, editing, and publishing; a hosting/publishing platform is available.

U1 and U7 are primarily investigation/design stories, but the estimates include prototype code needed to validate the resulting decisions; U1's estimate also covers implementing the chosen selection/fallback mechanism.

U5 scope is limited to the singlenode (local, single JVM) deployer; Cloud Foundry, Kubernetes, or other deployer targets are out of scope. The semantics referenced in PR #19 are assumed to define basic undeploy behavior.
For U6, only the in-memory backend for the 'local' profile is required in this increment; persistent backends (e.g., relational) are out of scope.
For U2, a Maven-compatible artifact repository (local/remote) is reachable at runtime for dependency resolution.
No clarifying answers are needed: ambiguities (e.g., exact metrics schema, exact binder fallback order) are resolved by the design decisions listed above.

activities.activity_name: Development environment and project setup
activities.activity_description: Set up JDK 17 toolchain, Maven builds for the s-c-d/s-c-s repositories, IDE configuration, and base project structure needed for the increment.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Investigate binder jar include/exclude mechanisms
activities.activity_description: Spike: analyze how message bus/binding jars are discovered and loaded in Spring Cloud Stream and evaluate mechanisms for explicit inclusion/exclusion of binder jars.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Design and implement binding selection and fallback mechanism
activities.activity_description: Define and implement the binding selection logic (configuration-driven include/exclude plus classpath detection) and the fallback behavior when no binding is configured.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Tests for binding selection and fallback
activities.activity_description: Unit and integration tests covering include/exclude combinations, single/multiple binders on the classpath, and the no-binder fallback path.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Design dependency resolution strategy
activities.activity_description: Evaluate options (Aether-based resolution, classloader isolation, shading) and design how conflicting jar versions across modules are resolved and loaded at runtime.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Implement dependency resolution service
activities.activity_description: Implement Maven Resolver (Aether)-based resolution of module artifacts and transitive dependencies, including version conflict resolution and artifact caching.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Integrate resolved artifacts into runtime module loading
activities.activity_description: Wire the resolution service into module launch so each module runs with its resolved classpath in an isolated classloader.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Tests for multi-module version conflict scenarios
activities.activity_description: Integration tests deploying modules that depend on different versions of the same library (e.g., different Spring Data versions) verifying correct bits load at runtime.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Create Dockerfile and image build for s-c-d
activities.activity_description: Author a Dockerfile building the s-c-d image from a layered executable jar and verify the image runs locally.

activities.activity_name: U3 - CI pipeline for automated DockerHub publishing
activities.activity_description: Configure the CI pipeline to build the image and push it to DockerHub on latest commits, including tag strategy (commit SHA plus latest).

activities.activity_name: U3 - Credentials management, validation, and docs
activities.activity_description: Set up DockerHub secrets in CI, validate end-to-end push/pull of published images, and document the publishing workflow.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Prepare firehose | counter demo stream
activities.activity_description: Build and verify a working firehose | counter stream demo environment suitable for recording, including sample data and dashboard visibility.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Script, record, edit, and publish screencast
activities.activity_description: Write the demo script, record the screencast demonstrating s-c-s and the development experience, edit the video, and publish it publicly.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Define consistent undeploy strategy for jobs and streams
activities.activity_description: Prerequisite design: specify undeploy semantics consistently across jobs and streams, aligned with the approach in the referenced PR.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Implement undeploy SPI and singlenode implementation
activities.activity_description: Add the undeploy operation to the deployer SPI and implement it for the singlenode (single JVM) target, stopping and removing running stream deployments.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Tests for undeploy lifecycle
activities.activity_description: Unit and integration tests covering undeploying a running stream, undeploying non-existent deployments, and lifecycle edge cases.

activities.activity_name: U6 - Design profile-based repository backend strategy
activities.activity_description: Design how Spring Profiles select the stream repository backend in the Admin application via conditional configuration.

activities.activity_name: U6 - Implement profiles and in-memory repository for local profile
activities.activity_description: Implement profile support in the core Admin application and a map-backed in-memory StreamRepository activated under the 'local' profile.

activities.activity_name: U6 - Profile-specific tests
activities.activity_description: Tests verifying correct backend activation per profile and CRUD behavior of the in-memory repository under the local profile.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Analyze Spring XD module model
activities.activity_description: Brainstorming/analysis: review the XD module model (sources, sinks, processors, options) and extract requirements for porting to s-c-s.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Design s-c-s module foundation
activities.activity_description: Design the base conventions, application model, and auto-configuration starters that will serve as the foundation for migrating XD modules to s-c-s modules.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Prototype module port and design documentation
activities.activity_description: Port one representative XD module as a proof of concept to validate the design, and document the foundation and migration approach.

activities.activity_name: U8 - Design counter metrics endpoint contract
activities.activity_description: Define the REST contract (paths, JSON payload) for counter metrics endpoints consumable by dashboards.

activities.activity_name: U8 - Implement counter metrics collection and endpoints
activities.activity_description: Implement counter storage and the Admin REST endpoints exposing counter values for the firehose | counter pipe.

activities.activity_name: U8 - Tests and dashboard feed verification
activities.activity_description: Unit/integration tests for the metrics endpoints and verification that a dashboard can consume the counter feed end to end.

activities.activity_name: Increment integration and regression testing
activities.activity_description: Cross-story integration, end-to-end regression testing of the increment (deploy, metrics, undeploy flows together), and defect fixing.

activities.activity_name: Code review, refactoring, and developer documentation
activities.activity_description: Self-review and refactoring of all increment code, plus README/reference documentation updates for the delivered features.
